questions.question: Which space mission will Shubhanshu Shukla pilot to the International Space Station?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Axiom Mission 4.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Indian astronaut Shubhanshu Shukla will pilot Axiom Mission 4 (Ax-4) to the International Space Station (ISS).**
 
• This mission is set to launch from **NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida** no earlier than spring 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shubhanshu Shukla** **will make history as the first Indian astronaut to visit the ISS aboard a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft.**
 
• The mission will be commanded by former NASA astronaut **Peggy Whitson**, with Shukla serving as the pilot.
 
• The mission is part of a series of private astronaut missions to the ISS, marking a new era of international space collaboration.
 
• This mission is a milestone for both ISRO and private space exploration, enhancing India’s space presence globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Axiom Space__

 __
 
• Axiom Space is a private space exploration company that facilitates commercial missions to the ISS.
 
• The Axiom Mission series is a key part of expanding private participation in low Earth orbit.
 
 
 
• SpaceX Dragon__
 __
 
• SpaceX Dragon is a spacecraft developed by SpaceX for cargo and crew transport to the ISS.
 
• It is used for NASA and private missions, featuring an advanced autonomous docking system.
 
 
 
• Gaganyaan Mission__
 
 
• India's first human spaceflight mission led by ISRO, scheduled to send Indian astronauts into space.
 
• The mission will demonstrate India's capabilities in human space exploration.

questions.question: By which year is India aiming to end tuberculosis (TB) under the national TB control initiatives?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2025.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 100-day TB campaign aims to end tuberculosis in India by 2025.**
 
• Manipur Governor Bhalla reviewed NIK-SHAY and TB Control initiatives in the state, emphasizing technology-driven measures and broad community engagement.
 
• The State Health Minister provided updates on the Pradhan Mantri TB Mukht Bharat Abhiyan, reinforcing the 2025 target.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India has set a goal to eliminate TB by 2025 under its national TB control initiatives.**
 
• NIK-SHAY is a TB patient management system used to track and provide support for those affected.
 
• The campaign involves increasing patient support, improving diagnosis, and introducing new treatment protocols.
 
• Mass community participation is considered crucial to meet the 2025 eradication target.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Pradhan Mantri TB Mukht Bharat Abhiyan__

 __
 
• An initiative aiming to eradicate TB in India by strengthening the healthcare system, ensuring availability of medicines, and providing nutritional support to TB patients.
 
• Encourages partnerships between government and private entities for enhanced TB surveillance and treatment coverage.
 
 
 
• NIK-SHAY__
 
 
• A digital platform used to track TB patients, ensuring they receive timely treatment and support.
 
• Facilitates data collection and monitoring, helping the government plan and execute TB control strategies effectively.

questions.question: Who has been honoured with the RK Srikantan Trust Award at the Sankranti Music Festival in Bengaluru?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**TV Gopalakrishnan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **T.V. Gopalakrishnan**, a renowned mridangist, has been honored with the **RK Srikantan Trust Award** during the **Sankranti Music Fest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• This prestigious recognition celebrates his **exceptional contributions** to Indian classical music.

questions.question: Which state has become the 34th state to implement the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Odisha**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Odisha** has become the **34th state** to join the **Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The scheme will work in **convergence** with the state's **Gopabandhu Jan Arogya Yojana (GJAY)**, providing comprehensive healthcare coverage.
 
• **Health cards** will be issued to beneficiaries, offering **₹5 lakh per family per year**, with an additional **₹5 lakh** for women members.
 
• The **MoU signing ceremony** was attended by **Union Health Minister JP Nadda**, **Odisha CM Mohan Charan Majhi**, and other key ministers including **Dharamendra Pradhan**, **Ashwini Vaishnaw**, and **Jual Oram**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Ayushman Bharat Overview:**

 
• **Launched**: As per the National Health Policy 2017, to achieve **Universal Health Coverage (UHC)** and align with the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
• **Aim**: Provide comprehensive, need-based healthcare services at primary, secondary, and tertiary levels. Focuses on prevention, promotion, and ambulatory care.

Main Components:

 
• 
 
**Health and Wellness Centres (HWCs)**:

 
 
• **Objective**: Transform **Sub Centres** and **Primary Health Centres** into 1,50,000 Health and Wellness Centres by 2022.
 
• **Services**: Comprehensive Primary Health Care (CPHC), maternal and child health, non-communicable diseases, essential drugs, and diagnostic services.
 
• **Focus**: Health promotion and prevention, empowering individuals and communities to adopt healthy behaviours and prevent chronic diseases.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)**:

 
 
• **Launched**: September 23, 2018, in Ranchi, Jharkhand.
 
• **Coverage**: ₹5 lakh per family per year for **secondary and tertiary care hospitalization** for **12 crore** poor and vulnerable families (about **55 crore beneficiaries**).
 
• **Eligibility**: Based on **Socio-Economic Caste Census 2011** (SECC), covers families previously under **Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY)**.

questions.question: Which country has officially become a full member of BRICS as announced by Brazil in January 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indonesia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Indonesia has officially joined BRICS as a full member, confirmed by Brazil's government.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indonesia is the world’s fourth most populous country and has expressed long-standing interest in joining BRICS.**
 
• The BRICS group now includes Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, and Indonesia.
 
• Indonesia's BRICS membership was approved at the 2023 BRICS summit in Johannesburg and finalized post-2024 presidential election.
 
• Indonesia’s inclusion is seen as a step to strengthen alliances among emerging nations and promote the goals of the Global South.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• BRICS__

 __
 
• BRICS is a group of major emerging economies, including Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, and now Indonesia, that aim to reform global governance and strengthen cooperation among developing nations.
 
• **Current Members__: Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran and UAE.**
 
• Iran, Egypt, Ethiopia, and UAE attended their first summit as member states at 2024 summit in Russia.
 
• It was founded in 16 June 2009.
 
 
 
• __Global South__
 
 
• The Global South refers to countries in Africa, Latin America, Asia, and Oceania that share common challenges related to development, inequality, and global governance reform.

questions.question: Which location is hosting India’s first-ever coastline and waders census?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Marine National Park and Sanctuary, Jamnagar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Gujarat is conducting India’s first coastline and waders census from January 3 to 5, 2025, at the Marine National Park and Sanctuary in Jamnagar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Marine National Park and Sanctuary is India’s first designated marine national park, covering 170 km of coastline and 42 islands.**
 
• It hosts over 300 species of local and migratory birds, including rare wader birds like the Crab Plover and Great Knot.
 
• The census is jointly organized by the Gujarat Forest Department and the Bird Conservation Society of Gujarat.
 
• Activities include expert talks, bird counting, and knowledge-sharing sessions over the three-day event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Marine National Park and Sanctuary:**__ Located in the Gulf of Kutch, it is a protected area established to conserve marine biodiversity and mangrove ecosystems.
 
• __**Jamnagar:**__ Known as a paradise for coastal birds, it supports numerous local and migratory bird species, including over 50 species of waders.
 
• __**Crab Plover (Shankhlo):**__ A rare wader bird species that thrives in Jamnagar but is seldom found elsewhere in India.
 
• __**Knowledge-Sharing Sessions:**__ These aim to raise awareness about conservation efforts and the importance of coastal ecosystems.

questions.question: Who released the book titled 'Jammu Kashmir and Ladakh: Through the Ages' on 2nd January 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Amit Shah**__

It presents the story of **Jammu Kashmir and Ladakh** from an accessible perspective, catering to both experts and general readers.

questions.question: Where is the first Green Hydrogen Hub under the National Green Hydrogen Mission being established?

The correct answer is __**Pudimadaka, Andhra Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the first Green Hydrogen Hub under the National Green Hydrogen Mission at Pudimadaka, Andhra Pradesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Green Hydrogen Hub project at Pudimadaka is valued at ₹1.85 lakh crore and is a part of the National Green Hydrogen Mission.**
 
• The project is aimed at promoting clean and sustainable energy in the region.
 
• The inauguration will be done virtually by Prime Minister Narendra Modi from Visakhapatnam.
 
• The hub will play a key role in India's efforts towards clean energy and reducing carbon emissions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Green Hydrogen__

 __
 
• Green hydrogen is produced using renewable energy sources and is considered a key element in the transition to clean energy.
 
 
 
• National Green Hydrogen Mission__
 
 
• A government initiative to promote the production and use of green hydrogen in India, aiming to reduce reliance on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.

questions.question: Which ministry does the National Turmeric Board come under?

options.text: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Ministry of Commerce and Industry__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Minister of Commerce and Industry, **Piyush Goyal**, inaugurated the **National Turmeric Board **in **Nizamabad, Telangana.**
 
• Shri Palle Ganga Reddy has been appointed as its first Chairperson.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The board will focus on:
 
 
• Welfare of turmeric farmers.
 
• Boosting exports and developing superior turmeric varieties.
 
• Research and creating value-added products.
 
 
 
• India produces **70% of the world’s turmeric** with over 30 varieties, many holding GI tags.
 
• National Turmeric Board is therefore headquartered in Nizamabad, Telangana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The board will also focus on improving logistics and creating awareness about turmeric's **medicinal properties**.
 
• It aims to expand trade into **newer markets** globally.

questions.question: Who succeeded S. Somanath as the Chairman of ISRO starting January 14, 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**V. Narayanan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **V. Narayanan took over as the Chairman of ISRO on January 14, 2025, succeeding S. Somanath.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Narayanan is a noted rocket and spacecraft propulsion expert.**
 
• He has been heading ISRO’s Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC) since January 2018.
 
• His tenure as Chairman will include overseeing significant projects like Gaganyaan and Chandrayaan-4 missions.
 
• **He will also assume the role of Secretary, Department of Space, and Chairman of the Space Commission, effective from January 14, 2025.**
 
• He worked on Solid Propulsion for Rockets, ASLV, and PSLV at Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre. 
 
• **Current Role: Director of LPSC , headquartered in Valiamala (Thiruvananthapuram).**
 
• Dr. Narayanan termed his upcoming role as “a great responsibility” and an “opportunity to follow in the footsteps of ISRO stalwarts.”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Gaganyaan Mission__

 __
 
• A human spaceflight mission by ISRO aiming to send Indian astronauts into space.
 
 
 
• Chandrayaan-4 Mission__
 
 
• A planned mission to explore the Moon, focusing on landing and collecting lunar data.

questions.question: HIMKAVACH, a cold weather clothing system for extreme conditions, was unveiled by which organization?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**DRDO**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **HimKavach** multi-layer clothing system is designed for extreme cold conditions, with a functional temperature range from **+20°C to -60°C**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Modular Design**: The system’s layers are adjustable, allowing soldiers to modify clothing based on the weather, which is crucial for high-altitude regions like the Himalayas.
 
• **Enhanced Protection**: HimKavach offers broader protection compared to the previous **Extreme Cold Weather Clothing System (ECWCS)**, ensuring better mobility, comfort, and operational readiness.
 
• **Successful Trials**: The system has successfully cleared all user trials in actual operational settings, providing improved insulation and comfort.
 
• **Operational Readiness**: HimKavach is designed to enhance the safety and effectiveness of soldiers in high-altitude, extreme cold regions, addressing ongoing security concerns along India’s Himalayan borders.
 
• **Deployment Expected Soon**: The clothing system will soon be deployed to improve mobility, durability, and efficiency for troops stationed in harsh environments.

 [IMAGE: https://akm-img-a-in.tosshub.com/indiatoday/images/story/202501/drdo-developed-himkavach-multi-layer-clothing-system-designed-for-temperature-range-of-20c-to--60-104623661-16x9_0.jpg?VersionId=B9cvMSodfTbt_nkefa1.vXyMPn96GU9d&size=690:388]

questions.question: Which specialized agency achieved a 100% conviction rate in 2024, convicting 68 accused in 25 cases?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**National Investigation Agency (NIA).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **NIA achieved a 100% conviction rate in 2024, convicting 68 accused in 25 cases.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **NIA is a specialized counter-terrorism agency established under the Ministry of Home Affairs.**
 
• The agency investigates terror-related crimes across states without requiring special permission from state governments.
 
• Founder: Radha Vinod Raju.
 
• Founded: 31 December 2008.
 
• Current Director General: Sadanand Date.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **National Investigation Agency (NIA)**__

 __
 
• Established after the 2008 Mumbai attacks to combat terrorism effectively.
 
• Empowered by the NIA Act, 2008, allowing it jurisdiction across India for terror-related crimes.
 
 
 
• **Conviction Rate**__
 
 
• Indicates the percentage of cases resulting in convictions out of total cases prosecuted.

questions.question: Which state won the Best Tableau award at the 76th Republic Day event for showcasing the 38th National Games?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Department of Information in Uttarakhand won the Best Tableau award during the 76th Republic Day celebrations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The tableau was based on the 38th National Games to be hosted in Uttarakhand.**
 
• It showcased various competitions along with Mallakhamb, a traditional sport native to the state.
 
• The award was presented by Governor Lieutenant General Gurmeet Singh (Retd) and Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami.
 
• The award was received by Director General of Information, Banshidhar Tiwari.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• 38th National Games__

 __
 
• The National Games is a multi-sport event organized in India, held once every four years.
 
• It includes various traditional and modern sports competitions.
 
• Mallakhamb is a traditional Indian sport featured prominently in the event.
 
• Indian Oil Corporation (IOC) has given preliminary consent as a bronze sponsor for the 38th National Games, hosted by Uttarakhand for the first time.
 
• The game mascot is named Mouli, inspired by the Monal, Uttarakhand's state bird.
 
• The tagline for the event is "Sankalp Se Shikhar Tak", which translates to "from resolution to zenith."
 
 
 
• Uttarakhand__
 
 
• Formed in - 2000
 
• Capital - Dehradun (winter), Gairsain (summer)
 
• Chief Minister - Pushkar Singh Dhami
 
• Governor - Lieutenant General Gurmeet Singh (Retd)

questions.question: What is the maximum coverage provided under the "Cashless Treatment" scheme launched by Union Minister Nitin Gadkari for road accident victims?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1.5 lakh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Minister Nitin Gadkari launched the "Cashless Treatment" scheme to cover road accident treatment costs up to ₹1.5 lakh for seven days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The "Cashless Treatment" scheme provides up to ₹1.5 lakh for accident victims' treatment if the police are informed within 24 hours.
 
• The scheme also offers ₹2 lakh ex-gratia payment for families of victims in hit-and-run cases.
 
• Road safety remains a top priority for the government with additional measures for safer transport of school children.
 
• The scheme aims to address the growing number of road accidents and reduce the financial burden on victims' families.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Ex-gratia Payment__

 __
 
• A payment made to the families of victims in exceptional cases such as hit-and-run accidents, to provide financial assistance in their time of need.
 
 
 
• Road Safety Measures__
 
 
• The government is implementing various measures, including helmet enforcement and safe transport systems for school children, to improve road safety across the country.

questions.question: What is the name of the book written by Shri Amitabh Kant about India's G20 Presidency and Summit?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**How India Scaled Mt G20.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **PM Narendra Modi lauds Amitabh Kant’s book on India’s G20 Presidency and Summit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The book is titled 'How India Scaled Mt G20.'**
 
• The book highlights the rigorous process behind the New Delhi Leader's Declaration for the G20 summit, including 16 failed drafts.
 
• The book details the 300 hours of discussions and 11 sleepless nights required to finalize the declaration.
 
• PM Modi praised the book for providing a lucid perspective on India’s human-centric development efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Amitabh Kant__

 
 
• Former CEO of NITI Aayog
 
• Played a key role in India’s G20 Presidency
 
• Author of 'How India Scaled Mt G20'
